title: Build a Trie (prefix tree) in Rust with insert, search, starts_with, and count_words
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement a Trie data structure with TrieNode children stored in a HashMap<char, TrieNode>. Support insert, search (exact match), starts_with (prefix check), and count_words (total inserted words).

required_artifacts: TrieNode with children: HashMap<char, TrieNode> and is_end: bool
insert walks the trie creating nodes as needed, sets is_end on last node
search returns true only when the full word path ends at an is_end node
starts_with returns true if the prefix path exists (is_end not required)
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
